segments.tha-ap489:1.3: Tattha me caṅkamo āsi, amanussehi māpito.
segments.tha-ap489:5.3: Sabbe sissā samāgantvā, etamatthaṃ pucchiṃsu maṃ [etamatthamapucchu maṃ (sī.), etamattaṃ apucchiṃsu (syā. ka.)].
segments.tha-ap489:6.1: “‘Pulinena kato thūpo [kato thūpe (sī.)], yaṃ tvaṃ deva [devaṃ (sī. pī.)] massati;
segments.tha-ap489:6.3: Mayampi ñātumicchāma, puṭṭho ācikkha no tuvaṃ’.
segments.tha-ap489:7.1: “‘Niddiṭṭhā nu [niddiṭṭhā no (sī. pī.), diṭṭhāno vo (syā.)] mantapade, cakkhumanto mahāyasā;
segments.tha-ap489:7.3: Te kho ahaṃ namassāmi, buddhaseṭṭhe mahāyase’.
segments.tha-ap489:10.3: Na tesaṃ jāṇu nadati, sandhisaddo na suyyati.
segments.tha-ap489:11.3: Paṭhamaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ pādaṃ, buddhānaṃ esa dhammatā.
segments.tha-ap489:12.3: Nevukkaṃsenti attānaṃ, no ca vambhenti pāṇinaṃ.
segments.tha-ap489:16.1: “‘Īdisā te mahānāgā, atulā ca [te (syā. ka.)] mahāyasā;
segments.tha-ap489:18.3: Saddahantā mama vākyaṃ, buddhasakkatamānasā [buddhattagatamānasā (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap489:20.3: Sabbe sissā samāgantvā, āgacchuṃ mama santike.
segments.tha-ap489:21.3: Susumārova [suṃsumārova (sī. syā. pī.)] saḷati, kiṃ vipāko bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap489:24.1: “Balañca vata me khīṇaṃ, byādhinā [byādhito (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] paramena taṃ;
segments.tha-ap489:24.3: Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ saritvāna, tattha kālaṅkato [kālakato (sī. pī.)] ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap489:28.3: Mā vo pamattā ahuttha [ahuvattha (sī.)], khaṇo vo paṭipādito’.
segments.tha-ap489:31.1: “Avasesesu kappesu, vokiṇṇo [vokiṇṇaṃ (sī. syā. ka.)] saṃsariṃ ahaṃ;
segments.tha-ap489:31.3: Duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi, uppādassa idaṃ phalaṃ [pulinapūjāyidaṃ phalaṃ (sī.)].
segments.tha-ap489:36.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap489:38.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā pulinuppādako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Kumāravaye uṭṭhitadantānaṃ patitattā puna uṭṭhitadantā dijā, te ca dantā.
